title: PR Review Agent Usage
description: One row per returned review-agent dispatch (completed or errored; a denied dispatch writes none) (pr-review and pr-team: reviewer, fixer, orchestrator, planner, closer), written by the pr-review-watch mod when the agent returns. Records who ran (role, subagent_type, model), its cost (tokens, tool_uses, duration_s) and, for fixer and closer rows, outcome counts. Loaded line-by-line as JSONL/NDJSON: each line of the data file is one complete object matching this schema.

logged_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the row was built.

run_id.description: The dispatch's RUN_ID (`pr<N>_<UTC yyyymmddTHHMMSSZ>`); groups the rows of one run.

pr.description: PR number under review, not zero-padded; null when the run names none.

skill.description: The skill that dispatched the run.

role.description: The tracked role. A roast is a reviewer; `subagent_type` or `agent_id` tells it apart.

agent_id.description: Slot id from the dispatch plan, or `orchestrator_plan` / `orchestrator_consolidate` / `fixer_plan` / `closer`.

subagent_type.description: The Agent call's `subagent_type`; null when the call named none.

model.description: Full model id: the engine-resolved model, else the requested one; null when neither is known.

model_family.description: The family token found in `model`; `unknown` when it holds none (or `model` is null).

tokens.description: Input + output + cache read + cache creation tokens, as the engine reports them; 0 when unmeasured.

signal.description: The return block's SIGNAL; `NO_BLOCK` when the agent returned without one; `ERROR` for an errored Agent result.

notes.description: `pr-review-watch auto row; <role> <signal>`, plus `; usage not measured` when the engine reported no usage, or `; usage not measured; agent errored` for an errored result.

issues_assigned.description: Fixer and closer rows only. Number of issues the fixer was assigned (pr-review: the length of its `issue_ids` in the run's waves.json; pr-team: always null, the block carries no assignment); null when unknown.

issues_fixed.description: Fixer and closer rows only. Issues fixed (pr-review: the report's `fixed`; pr-team: the block's FIXED ids); null when unknown.

issues_bubbled.description: Fixer and closer rows only. Issues bubbled (pr-review: the report's `bubbled`; pr-team: the block's BUBBLED ids); null when unknown.

files_touched.description: Fixer and closer rows only. Distinct files edited (pr-review: `files` across the report's `fixed` entries; pr-team: the block's EDITED count); null when unknown.

then.description: Fixer and closer rows carry the four outcome counts (null when unknown).

else.description: Every other role carries none of the outcome counts.
